p.title: Classify a resource

nodes.text: Strong winds over the Rajasthan desert
nodes.info: Only a part of this wind is used to make electricity.

nodes.text: Does it have life (from the biosphere)?
nodes.info: Forests, fisheries and livestock have life.
Has life: forests, fisheries, livestock.
Non-living: rocks, metals — and wind.

nodes.text: Can it be renewed or reproduced?
nodes.info: Solar energy, wind and forests can be renewed.
E.g. solar energy, wind, forests.
Forms over very long geological times: coal, petroleum, minerals.

nodes.text: Is all of it being used yet?
nodes.info: A resource found in a region but not yet used is potential.
Surveyed, and its quality and quantity worked out for use.
Found in a region but not yet used — like most of Rajasthan’s wind.

p.challenge: Classify the Rajasthan desert wind: choose the right answer at each question. Is it biotic or abiotic, renewable or not, potential or developed?
